findings.title: Hard-delete race with checkout
findings.detail: VariantService.remove counts OrderItems before opening the transaction. An order placed in that window leaves an OrderItem pointing at a hard-deleted variant whose inventory row was cascaded away, so confirmSale/release/adjust throw NotFound. Re-check the count inside the transaction, or soft-delete when inventory.reserved > 0.

findings.title: Last-active guard not atomic
findings.detail: Two concurrent removes of a published product's last two active variants can both pass the count check. This fails closed: the product is hidden from the storefront and can't be re-published until a variant is added or restored.

findings.title: Low-stock report lists removed variants
findings.detail: ReportingService.inventory() has no isActive filter, so soft-deleted variants with <=10 units still appear. Add variant: { isActive: true } to the where.

findings.title: Autocomplete suggests unpurchasable products
findings.detail: PostgresSearchProvider.autocomplete filters only on status 'published'. Add variants: { some: { isActive: true } } to match search().
